summary_en: HENNGE raises FY2026 September year-end dividend forecast by 5 yen to 8 yen per share, citing solid earnings and stable financial position. Combined with the interim dividend of 3 yen already paid, annual dividend guidance for FY2026 reaches 11 yen per share, up from previous forecast of 9 yen.
title_en: Notice Regarding Revision of Dividend Forecast (Dividend Increase)
translation_en_brief:
HENNGE revised its dividend forecast for the fiscal year ending September 2026. The company raised the year-end dividend per share by 5 yen from the previous forecast of 3 yen to 8 yen per share. Combined with the interim dividend of 3 yen already distributed, the total annual dividend per share is now expected to reach 11 yen, compared to the previous full-year forecast of 9 yen.

The revision reflects solid earnings performance and a stable financial position. The company stated that its basic dividend policy aims to balance internal reserves for growth investments with shareholder returns while maximizing shareholder value. Although the company had initially planned a progressive dividend increase with a year-end dividend of 3 yen, the improved business performance and financial stability led management to increase the year-end dividend by an additional 5 yen to 8 yen per share.
